fit.title: Component valuation / residual-income cross-check
fit.reason: A diversified holding company needs a sum-of-parts review. Residual income is a cross-check for its financial businesses, not a complete valuation of every subsidiary.
fit.caution: No fully automated sum-of-parts model is available. Review subsidiaries, investments, insurance float and holding-company adjustments separately.
fit.statement: No model is always most accurate. This is an explainable starting point, not a verified survey of current Wall Street analyst usage.
